item.title: Israeli strikes pound south of Beirut, displacing more than 100,000 in a day
item.summary: In the space of 24 hours, more than 100,000 people fled in #Lebanon amid #Israeli strikes. About 667,000 people have been displaced since the start of the attacks, which started following that of #Hezbollah on #Israel.
